acceptance_criteria: Every promoted, discarded, rejected, retriable, and partially written decision names a versioned scoped source generation without storing source content in telemetry.
Provider output is strictly bounded and every returned source record ID is unique and belongs to the exact input cluster.
Unchanged completed sources and durable outputs cannot re-enter the same consolidation decision window.
Concurrent or restarted runs cannot reserve or promote the same source generation twice, and stale ownership cannot commit a later decision.
Remote-success and local-ledger ambiguity has a deterministic idempotent reconciliation path that cannot manufacture a second promotion.
Corrections, deletions, and superseding evidence propagate through explicit lineage transitions rather than orphaning or silently overwriting prior decisions.
Existing promote-only records have an explicit migration, quarantine, replay, or retirement disposition.
Health and alerts expose bounded decision counts, ages, and outcome classes without memory text, claims, identities, source IDs, provider output, or raw errors.
blast_radius: Memory candidate selection, scoped clustering, model-output validation, durable promotion identity, source provenance, retries and partial writes, correction and deletion propagation, scheduler health, retention, operator audit, and migration of existing promoted records.
evidence_summary: Three body-free live reads agreed on the open issue identity, empty labels, update time, URL, 13,463-byte body length, and body hash while API and SSH main both resolved to the exact pin. At exact main, runConsolidation performs an unfiltered semantic search, selects up to 100 recent records, and never marks, supersedes, or checkpoints the source records it processes. Each confirmed promotion writes a newly current user_fact with a claim-derived identifier and a fresh createdAt, but sourceMessagePks stays empty and the only lineage is a comma-joined provider-supplied evidence string. The DurableKnowledge model declares observation count and first, last, and promotion times, but the persisted promotion path does not populate that contract. A later run can therefore select the same unsuperseded sources and newly promoted output again, while overwrite, rewording, partial-write, and source-membership history remain unauditable. The exact-pin union falsifier run passed 455 of 455 tests across ten files with no skips; the consolidation suites preserve current promote-only and reprocessing behavior rather than disproving it. Three complete stable open-PR captures each enumerated 32 PRs, 26 drafts, 36 changed-file pages, 32 closing-reference pages, and 1,152 file rows with digest 0b0a74fc0fe95b70e7c03b96002dac4708e3cf9a0324bb553527f8ce69db0995. No open PR body or closing reference owns this target. PR #2451 has one target-specific coordination comment in the fully paginated 32-comment and 77-item timeline frontier, but its 13-file taxonomy-only change adds no consolidation lineage implementation, so it is partial rather than an owner. falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified by exact-main code that atomically records a versioned source-to-promotion decision, prevents unchanged sources and already-promoted outputs from re-entering the same decision window, validates every returned source ID against the scoped cluster, and preserves retry-safe partial-write history. Exact source has none. The implementation still must choose whether decisions are append-only or superseding and define replay, correction, deletion, retention, and remote-write ambiguity semantics.
impact: Repeated cycles can spend model and remote-write capacity on the same evidence, overwrite promotion history under a stable claim-derived ID, amplify a promoted record as if it were new evidence, and leave operators unable to prove which source generation produced or superseded durable knowledge.

suggested_remediation: Introduce a durable versioned consolidation decision ledger keyed by scoped source generation and algorithm version. Validate provider output structurally and require every source ID to be a unique member of the input cluster; atomically reserve or checkpoint source generations before remote mutation, use idempotent promotion generations, and record confirmed, rejected, retriable, partial, and superseded outcomes. Exclude durable outputs and completed unchanged sources from subsequent candidate selection while preserving explicit correction and replay paths, bounded retention, privacy-safe health, and migration behavior.
